name: Text behind an object
description: A title in the scene that disappears behind a wall, a pillar or a car: one click on the object makes a mask of its even surface, the object stays in front of the words and both follow a tracker.
description_de: Ein Titel in der Szene, der hinter einer Wand, einer Säule oder einem Auto verschwindet: ein Klick auf das Objekt macht aus seiner gleichfarbigen Fläche eine Maske, das Objekt bleibt vor den Worten und beides folgt einem Tracker.
description_en: A title in the scene that disappears behind a wall, a pillar or a car: one click on the object makes a mask of its even surface, the object stays in front of the words and both follow a tracker.
note: Pick the object in front: {op:'pick_region', clip, at, point:[x, y], add:true} (0..1 of the picture; look with `frames` first) makes mask 6 the outline of the even surface you point at and puts tracker 2's point on structure at its edge; combine:'add' / 'subtract' adds or takes away another surface. Then {op:'track_node', clip, node:2} so text and mask stay in the scene when the camera moves (a surface in perspective: track_node with mode:'quad' and corners - the mask follows them in perspective). Check with `frames` {clip, node:7}.

soft.description: soft edge of the object's outline in project pixels
